description: Replaces Dependabot. Library dependencies reach every consumer through the published POM, so Gradle updates always wait for a person. Renovate merges its own GitHub Actions patch, minor, pin and digest PRs once CI is green and the release is 3 days old.

packageRules.description: Automerge GitHub Actions patch, minor, pin and digest updates once CI passes and the release has aged

These actions only run on main, on a release or after another workflow, or in the Maven Central publish job, so no PR check covers how they are used there. Never automerge. Renovate names every gradle/actions sub-action (setup-gradle, dependency-submission) gradle/actions
